author: nixo.eth
content:
it was [PR'd](<https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12074>) in time for the Hegotá upgrade but so far hasn't been brought to an ACD call. in order for it to be moved to "proposed", someone has to actively champion the EIP and present it at a call. [this Thursday's ACDE](<https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2197>) is the last chance before it gets dropped, if you'd like to present and champion it

if you'd like to, just comment on that issue to add it to the agenda and be prepared to introduce the EIP for ~2 minutes at the call
